title: Cognitive task identification from fMRI maps
scientific_question: Can a neural map identify the cognitive task on a held-out participant without map filenames or task-coded masks?
primary_outputs: Task probabilities from sanitized, geometrically qualified maps using a fixed source-locked ontology and comparable contrast construction; remove task/contrast tags from filenames, headers and masks.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

allowed_inputs.proposed_scope: Expected source-specific input: task/run/contrast fMRI maps and condition/design metadata. Query maps must omit labels and source filename cues.
allowed_inputs.allowed_context_policy: Only target-permitted variables may enter the query; all this task targets, future variables, answer-bearing filenames and evaluation labels stay private. Encoding receives stimuli/history with training neural responses and hides query neural targets.

case_definition: Proposed biological-unit/session packet with nested scored observations; exact eligible cases unknown until source audit.

split.policy: Whole-person holdout with session, AP/PA/FFX and contrast-family dependencies retained. Replace the author66-fold StratifiedKFold for this contract; do not treat groups passed but unused as participant independence.
split.uncertainty: Group at biological unit, with source-specific stimulus/block dependence; do not promote neuron/trial counts to independent animals.

reference.role: Pinned author map/dictionary and classification analyses. The inspected decoder splitter is not participant-disjoint, and dictionary analysis is not yet an unseen-task predictor.

controls: No task filenames/contrast labels in query

common_policy.fixed_program: Freeze program and fitting/adaptation recipe before query access; any target-batch adaptation must be explicitly permitted.
common_policy.case_adaptive: Same allowed data, checkpoint tools, context batch and accounted compute; no evaluator labels/feedback; reset case state as specified.
common_policy.model_tools: Compare generic numerical tools, supplied decoder alone, and matched agent-plus-decoder arms. Record checkpoint training exposure and preparation cost.
common_policy.investigation: Require estimand, numeric artifacts, uncertainty, alternative explanations and executable evidence; independent scorer verifies them.

evaluation.comparability: Distinct assignment within a shared task family/source; no new dataset/cohort claimed for paradigms, modalities or file versions.

unresolved_grading.requirement: Freeze exact sample eligibility, target definition, primary metric, split, access rules and resource budget before outcomes.

resources.basis: Unmeasured estimate. Use bounded existing derivatives/reference features; full-source procurement and model training are not implied.
